Name: Kenneth's Christmas Gift
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Merry Christmas, farmer![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Santa Kenneth heard you've been a good farmer this year, so you're getting a little something every Winter 25.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This isn't OP or game-breaking, just a generous thank you gift to make winter a bit warmer and next year a bit easier.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What's inside:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Christmas Tree, Winter Banner, Light String, Winter Seeds, Cookies, Chocolate Cakes, 5x Golden Mystery Boxes, 2x Chests, Diamonds, Ancient Seeds, Iridium Sprinklers, Auto-Petter, Stardrop Tea, Starfruit and 25,000g.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Details:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Arrives yearly via mail on Winter 25[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Balanced, not cheaty[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Works with 1.6+[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Super Lightweight - only Content Patcher, no extra dependencies, no performance impact[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- 1 version only, simple install[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Enjoy, and happy holidays![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility: All of my yearly mail gift mods are on separate mod pages but they work perfectly together with no conflicts and no overwrites. You can install just one or all of them if you want to experience celebrations throughout the whole year - your choice! Full list:[/b][/size]
